_: Tier 2 generation contract. Required by the Award-Winning Web UI/UX Style Bible before any markup (see DECISIONS.md Non-Negotiable Constraints). Vocabulary is taken from the bible's composition_zones/zones.json and patterns/. Human rationale lives in DECISIONS.md D-A20.
dominant_idea: A system that proves itself. Select a guard and see both the code it protects and the sabotage case that proves the guard actually bites.
_patterns_note: Two, not the permitted three. A third pattern would compete with the explainer for the stage.
_narrative_note: Order is fixed by the pattern's own rules: start with a plain-language premise, give overview before detail, and keep sources and assumptions beside results.
_clusters_note: Two of the permitted three. There is deliberately NO primary_action cluster: D-A13 rules out conversion furniture, and this tier asks nothing of the visitor.

zones.carries: the premise in plain language, and an honest next cue
the explainer: guard list against the code and its sabotage case
which subsystem is in view; collapses to a label on small screens
the readable non-interactive explanation of what the guards are and why they exist
provenance stamps: run date, commit, counts

card_policy: No cards for projects. The existing typographic index stands (D-A10) because titles are more useful than thumbnails here. Cards are permitted in exactly one place: a side-by-side guard comparison, where the items are genuine peers being scanned simultaneously.

data_contract.source: a stamped JSON snapshot generated from a real run
forbidden: any figure that cannot be regenerated from a real run on the day it ships
presenting a snapshot as a live reading
fetching from a machine that is not reachable from a static page
counting inherited upstream tests as Jordan's own
data_contract._: D-A18 and D-A19 applied under the repo's no-build-tools constraint.

responsive_transformations: Flatten the split stage into sequential sections, preserving semantic reading order.
Replace hover-only disclosure on guard rows with tap and focus.
Move edge annotations into the content flow when touch insets get narrow.
Cap display typography and re-author line breaks at representative widths.
Collapse the narrative rail to a single label that still says where you are.
reduced_motion_equivalent: Static keyframes in the same narrative order. The explainer becomes an expanded static list: every guard rendered with its code and sabotage case inline, nothing hidden behind a transition.

failure_behaviour.no_javascript: The premise, the readable explanation, every guard with its code and sabotage case, and the full project index are all present as real markup. The explainer degrades to a long document, not a blank stage.
failure_behaviour.no_canvas_or_webgl: Not used in this tier at all. The spatial canvas is quarantined to tier 3 (D-A17, D-A19).
failure_behaviour.snapshot_missing: Render the explanation without figures and say the snapshot is missing. Never substitute an estimate.

accessibility_contract: Every explainer state is reachable by keyboard.
Every guard has its own linkable fragment.
Semantic document order is preserved beneath the visual composition.
Animation shows causality only; it never rewards a click.
self_check: Can a visitor with JS disabled still read every guard, its code, and its sabotage case?
Is the important path understandable before any spectacle appears?
Does the interface frame the evidence, or consume it?
Is every number on the page regenerable from a real run today?
Are there still only two persistent clusters?
